EXCL-NO-FUZZ-MUTATION.reason: There is no custom parser or generative suite yet. Structural rejection is covered by JSON Schema negative tests.

EXCL-NO-DISTRIBUTED-RUNTIME.reason: The shipped client is an offline single-device placeholder with no server, queue, or replicated state.

EXCL-NO-PRODUCT-PERSISTENCE.reason: Local profile runtime is not implemented. Device saves are gitignored and out of scope for this slice.

EXCL-NO-OPERATIONS-LOAD.reason: No hosted deployment, load profile, or fault-injection harness exists for a title-screen stub.

EXCL-NO-PERSONAL-DATA-PROCESSING.reason: This slice does not collect personal data, so export, consent, deletion, de-identification, and retention jobs do not exist. Remaining privacy categories are covered by PII and analytics gates.

EXCL-NO-ACCOUNT-SECURITY-SURFACE.reason: No accounts, sessions, tenants, crypto protocol, or playable economy exist in this slice.

EXCL-NO-CLOUD-INFRA-CONFIG.reason: This repository has no cloud, container, or network infrastructure manifests to scan.
